questions.q: How do you say 'Smoking is harmful to health'?
options: Rauchen ist gut für die Gesundheit
Rauchen ist schädlich für die Gesundheit
questions.explain: 'Schädlich' = 'harmful' and 'für die Gesundheit' = 'for health', so this is correct.

questions.q: How do you say 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Ich streite mich mit meiner Schwester
Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Schwester
Ich ärgere mich über meine Schwester
questions.explain: 'Sich gut verstehen mit' means 'to get on well with', so this is 'I get on well with my sister'.
'Die Bewerbung' means 'the (job) application'; 'sich bewerben' = to apply.
'Bestehen' means 'to pass', so 'eine Prüfung bestehen' = 'to pass an exam'. To fail is 'durchfallen'.
'Die Erkältung' means 'a cold' (the illness); 'sich erkälten' = 'to catch a cold'.
'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.
'Witzig' means 'funny/witty' (from 'der Witz' = joke).
False friend: 'das Gymnasium' is a 'grammar school'. A gym is 'die Turnhalle'.

questions.q: How do you say 'My favourite subject is biology'?
questions.explain: 'Das Lieblingsfach' = 'favourite subject' and 'Biologie' = biology.
'Abnehmen' means 'to lose weight'; 'zunehmen' means 'to put on weight'.
'Älter' means 'older', so 'mein älterer Bruder' = 'my older brother'. 'Jünger' would be younger.

questions.q: How do you say 'I am looking for a job'?
questions.explain: 'Suchen' = 'to look for' and 'eine Stelle' = 'a job/position'; 'besuchen' (to visit) is the near-miss.
'Die Spritze' means 'an injection/jab'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'School starts at quarter past eight'?
options: Die Schule beginnt um halb acht
Die Schule endet um Viertel nach acht
Die Schule beginnt um Viertel vor acht
Die Schule beginnt um Viertel nach acht
questions.explain: 'Viertel nach acht' = 'quarter past eight'; 'vor' (to) is the distractor.
'Zuverlässig' means 'reliable/dependable' (related to 'sich verlassen auf').

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to become a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Ich möchte... werden' = 'I would like to become' and 'Krankenpfleger' = 'nurse'; 'krank' (ill) is a near-miss distractor.
'Die Glatze' means 'a bald head'; 'eine Glatze haben' = 'to be bald'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to become an engineer'?
questions.explain: 'Moechte ... werden' = 'would like to become'; 'der Ingenieur' = engineer.

questions.q: How do you say 'I work part-time in a shop'?
options: Ich arbeite Teilzeit in einem Geschäft
Ich arbeite Vollzeit in einem Geschäft
Ich suche Teilzeit in einem Geschäft
Ich arbeite Teilzeit in einer Schule
questions.explain: 'Teilzeit' = 'part-time' (Vollzeit = full-time) and 'ein Geschäft' = 'a shop'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We are not allowed to use mobile phones'?
questions.explain: 'Duerfen ... keine' = 'are not allowed to' and 'benutzen' = 'to use'.
